dispositions.root_cause: Astrologer model lacked availability and rating compound indexes in class Settings.
dispositions.fix_description: Added compound indexes for [('is_listed', 1), ('availability.is_online', 1)] and [('rating.average', -1)] in Astrologer.Settings.indexes alongside user_id and slug indexes.

verification_evidence.notes: Asserted existence of compound availability and rating sort indexes.

dispositions.root_cause: Public authentication and scanning endpoints lacked sliding-window rate limiting middleware.
dispositions.fix_description: Implemented InMemoryRateLimiter and RateLimitingMiddleware enforcing strict rate limits on auth and public endpoints with HTTP 429 Retry-After responses.

verification_evidence.notes: Verified HTTP 429 response, Retry-After header, and bypass header support.

dispositions.root_cause: Default settings allowed DEBUG=True in production configurations if not explicitly set to False.
dispositions.fix_description: Added Pydantic field validator forcing DEBUG to False when APP_ENV is 'production', preventing internal stack trace leaks.

verification_evidence.notes: Verified that Settings(APP_ENV='production', DEBUG=True).DEBUG evaluates to False.

dispositions.root_cause: Next.js 16.4.3 dependency subject to active npm security advisory.
dispositions.fix_description: Awaiting human authorization for 'next upgrade --agent=security' worktree execution choice per Scope & Safety Approval Gates.

verification_evidence.command_executed: npm run build in Admin and Web
verification_evidence.notes: Builds compile cleanly (0 errors); upgrade command pending user prompt choice.

dispositions.blocking_reason: Next.js upgrade CLI explicitly requires user worktree choice prior to running dependency upgrade.
dispositions.remaining_risk: Unpatched Next.js 16.4.3 framework advisory until upgrade command is executed.

dispositions.root_cause: Next.js Turbopack lacked root directory configuration in polyrepo/monorepo structure.
dispositions.fix_description: Configured turbopack: { root: path.resolve(__dirname, '..') } in next.config.ts for both Admin and Web.

verification_evidence.command_executed: npm run build in Astra-Astrology-Admin and Astra-Astrology-Web
verification_evidence.notes: Verified that 'Next.js ignored package-lock.json' warning is completely eliminated.

dispositions.root_cause: Test suites skip 343 tests when external payment and cloud credentials are absent.
dispositions.fix_description: Created offline test suite with deterministic mocks; broader mock fixture coverage for live webhook suites scheduled for test sprint.

verification_evidence.notes: All remediation tests execute offline without requiring external credentials.

dispositions.remaining_risk: 343 live gateway test cases remain skipped in offline environments until mock cassettes are generated.

dispositions.root_cause: Mobile video and chat screens omitted ScreenCapture.preventScreenCaptureAsync() calls.
dispositions.fix_description: Added ScreenCapture.preventScreenCaptureAsync() on mount and allowScreenCaptureAsync() on unmount in call/[id].tsx and chat/[id].tsx.

verification_evidence.notes: Verified 0 TypeScript errors with expo-screen-capture integration across 101 mobile screens.

dispositions.root_cause: AIChatSession conversation memories persisted indefinitely without automated TTL.
dispositions.fix_description: Added expireAfterSeconds=7776000 (90-day retention) TTL index on updated_at in AIChatSession.Settings.

verification_evidence.notes: Asserted expireAfterSeconds==7776000 on updated_at index in AIChatSession.
